scope: Complete historical evidence, finite thread sweep, one matched A/B pair and separate final-runtime/recovery observations. No dynamic mode-boundary performance, physical cable, reboot or pen-only input guarantee.
portable_id_policy: history/... values are portable logical evidence IDs, not promises that the original artifacts are publicly hosted. Original-byte SHA-256 values bind the preserved originals; raw_rows and summaries here are a sanitized numerical projection.

metric_definitions.cpu_ratio: Candidate process CPU seconds divided by matched denominator CPU seconds; below 1 is lower CPU cost.
metric_definitions.cpu_ms_per_simulated_grab: 1000 times median process CPU seconds per run divided by its simulated grab count; includes synthetic input mutation and worker CPU, excludes EVDI/kernel copies, FIFO, FFmpeg, GPU and end-to-end latency.
metric_definitions.confidence_intervals: Original 95% bootstrap intervals, if present, are copied verbatim from recorded summaries and have not been re-bootstrapped for this report. Pair ranges are not confidence intervals.

stages.algorithm: Original release helper processes damage notifications without exact source RGB suppression.
Exact RGB reference comparison, but every actual change copies the whole reference and still converts all damaged rows.
stages.retention_or_rejection_reason: Last-pixel-change regression in the initial matched microbenchmark caused replacement with actual-change row masks.

stages.algorithm: Compare used RGB channels exactly, suppress identical content, and derive dirty rows from actual changes; preserve keepalive, writer and buffer correctness.
stages.retention_or_rejection_reason: Retained idle and small-change behavior; full-change reference/copy cost motivated later conversion work.

stages.algorithm: Move reference snapshots next to conversion and group source rows belonging to a chroma row; worker bands are disjoint.
stages.retention_or_rejection_reason: Reduced overhead only slightly; insufficient final result. This early snapshot scheduling fusion differs from the later fused load/conversion path.

stages.algorithm: Compiler SIMD hints/vectorization accelerate native conversion.
stages.retention_or_rejection_reason: Native results improved, while scaled conversion retained excess cost; replaced by common packed-byte converter.

stages.algorithm: Reuse vectorized byte converter for native and scaled paths; keep identical integer averaging using packed B,G,R,0 scratch.
stages.retention_or_rejection_reason: Matched repeated helper benchmarks and byte-equivalence checks support retained common converter.
No reliable additional benefit in the short matched comparison.

stages.algorithm: OR reduction over groups of sixteen pixels without first-pixel shortcut.
stages.retention_or_rejection_reason: Target-case gains accompanied a full-frame single-thread regression in the short trial.

stages.algorithm: Raw comparison grouped across a whole source-row chroma band.
stages.retention_or_rejection_reason: No stable static-content gain; added complexity rejected.

stages.algorithm: Preserve fast raw-row comparison; check first RGB pixel immediately, then sixteen-pixel bitwise OR reduction plus scalar tail.
stages.retention_or_rejection_reason: Seven-pair comparisons support targeted unused-channel and moving-bar gains with small scaled-path cost. Exact comparison is retained; hashes are not used as change detection.

stages.algorithm: Retained comparison/conversion changes integrated over the later upstream event-handling base.
stages.retention_or_rejection_reason: Committed and separately compared against the later upstream base; source is different from both original release and subsequent uncommitted improvements.

stages.algorithm: Later upstream helper, including the event-loop behavior introduced upstream after the early release comparison base.
stages.retention_or_rejection_reason: Explicit denominator used for the publication microbenchmark.

stages.algorithm: GCC target_clones avx2/default variants on the conversion strips.
stages.retention_or_rejection_reason: Native full/noise/bar cases regressed; no production AVX2 dispatch retained.

stages.algorithm: GCC target_clones sse4.1/default variants on the conversion strips.
stages.retention_or_rejection_reason: No reliable overall additional performance benefit.

stages.algorithm: Release a writer buffer claim before idle skip; wait for the existing keepalive deadline with immediate publication signals; attempt smaller FIFO allocations when growth fails.
stages.retention_or_rejection_reason: Focused timing, wakeup, mutation and FIFO regression evidence supports behavior. No isolated matched CPU benchmark quantifies this stage.
limitations: SIMD benchmark files compare rejected SIMD candidates against the pre-writer source. They do not measure the writer/FIFO patch.

stages.algorithm: Handwritten 128-bit SSE2 color arithmetic, preserving a C fallback.
stages.retention_or_rejection_reason: Byte-equivalent outputs but no reliable overall performance advantage in matched synthetic measurements.

stages.algorithm: Capture native source-reference bytes in the same loaded path used by NV12 conversion; scaled paths keep separate snapshots.
stages.retention_or_rejection_reason: Long matched microbenchmark supports native full/noise/bar improvement; correctness retained; scaled path is control coverage.
limitations: This is not the rejected early reference-band scheduling fusion.
No end-to-end latency, GPU or whole-system energy gain is established by the helper benchmark.

superseded_receipt.reason: The owner reran the layout check after closing display settings and overwrote the receipt with a later timestamp. The prior bytes are no longer available at this evidence ID. The projected geometry, primary assignment, profiles, bindings and CTMs were rechecked against the replacement and remain unchanged; no numerical benchmark record changed.
superseded_receipt.change_scope: Owner-reported timestamp-only receipt recheck; unchanged projected layout facts directly compared during this provenance update.

thread_sweep.scope: One synthetic helper at a time. Timed stage is actual grab_now with fake full-damage EVDI boundary: RGB change detection, dirty masks, NV12 conversion and publication. Source generation, setup, verification and consume are outside stage timers. No EVDI, FIFO, FFmpeg, GPU or real stream.
thread_sweep.timing_scope: Actual grab_now wall and process CPU, excluding synthetic source updates, setup, warmup, consume and byte oracle; no kernel copy/FIFO/writer/encoder/GPU.
thread_sweep.order: For each size/case, even repeat order 1/2/4/8, odd repeat 8/4/2/1. Pair ratios within same size/case/repeat.
thread_sweep.statistics: Absolute values are medians of five run means; p95 is median of five run p95s, not a pooled percentile. Ratios pair same repeat to eight threads; ranges are observed extrema, not confidence intervals.
thread_sweep.oracle_limit: Full byte equality against the production one-thread full converter, preserving/restoring incremental RGB reference cache. This is equivalence across variants, not an independent color-standard oracle.

independent_historical_audit.verdict: Finite sweep source/equivalence/arithmetic subevidence confirmed; no production-policy or three-helper result inferred.

integration_source_snapshot.scope: Source identities for descriptive integration sections; this is not a fresh build/test attestation or final runtime-policy closure.

portable_benchmark.difference_from_historical_harness: Relative include and runtime g_conv_thread_limit instead of four MAX_CONV_THREADS source variants; requested and actual thread counts reported. Verify mode has0 warmup; measure mode retains24.
portable_benchmark.local_check: Generic gcc-O3 build plus four one-frame verify cases, caps1/2/4/8, zero byte errors. Initial checker parsing helper diagnostics failed; corrected JSON-record parser passed. No timing series executed.
portable_benchmark.warning: The included production helper emits its existing find_evdi_device snprintf truncation warning; that device path is not called by this harness.
